# Onefinestay

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 8 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Luxury vacation-rental marketing: a transparent header over a photo hero, Tiempos headings and Akkurat UI, a 2px white search bar with a coral square button, rust availability buttons, and a neutral-700 footer.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public marketing only; enquire was measured empty and not submitted; no booking, card, or account). Themes: light.

onefinestay's public marketing site, measured on 2026-11-19 while signed out. Pages: home, list your home, enquire, London destination, one listing, journal, and London search. No account was created. No booking, enquiry, or card was submitted. The preview tab reported innerWidth 1440 and innerHeight 900 at devicePixelRatio 2 after a 1440 by 900 request, and innerWidth 390 and innerHeight 844 at devicePixelRatio 2 after a 390 by 844 request. The product painted light only.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

There are no screenshots in this package. The coverage table names the pages that were measured. It cannot show them.

`--accent` resolves to `#f5f5f5`. The painted coral is `--brand-500` (`#ff8065`). The catalog swatch uses brand 500. A reader who follows the shadcn `--accent` name will paint a grey page.

`--primary` resolves to `#171717`. Painted headings and buttons use `--neutral-900` (`#26232a`) and, for the booking control, `--brand-900` (`#c84908`). The token `light.text.primary` is neutral 900, because that is what the headings computed to.

The journal at `/journal` loads `_compiled/app.css`, not the Next.js sheets. Its body colour computed to `rgb(15, 24, 39)`. Its coral tag computed to `#fe7f63`, which is `--brand-400`, not `--brand-500`. Do not treat the journal as the same token layer.

`--font-heatwood` is declared. No captured element computed to it.

The search button radius is 0. The search bar, field shells and text buttons are 2px. `--radius` is 0.625rem (10px) and was not the painted control radius.

Focus was read by calling `focus()` on the Garden chip. The box-shadow was `rgb(0, 102, 204) 0px 0px 0px 2px`. A keyboard-only pass was not done.

Akkurat's computed generic family was `serif`. The font files are Akkurat Std. The stack in the tokens copies the computed family string.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Set headings in Tiempos at weight 400, and UI text in Akkurat.** The home hero computed to 64px/72px Tiempos 400. Body copy computed to 16px/24px Akkurat 400. Labels computed to 12px/16px Akkurat 700. The wordmark is in [icons/wordmark.svg](icons/wordmark.svg).
2. **Use coral `#ff8065` for search and eyebrows, and rust `#c84908` for the availability button.** The home search square computed to `rgb(255, 128, 101)`. Check Availability computed to `rgb(200, 73, 8)`. The filled submit on enquire computed to `rgb(38, 35, 42)`. The favicon raster is [icon.png](icon.png).
3. **Keep control corners at 2px, and the search square square.** Field shells, text buttons and the search bar computed to 2px. The search button computed to 0. Filter chips computed to 24px. The menu icon is in [icons/menu.svg](icons/menu.svg).
